all_pending.title: Replace fixed R&D cadence with event-triggered research cycles
all_pending.description: R&D last ran 64h ago and fires on a fixed 3-day clock. Markets don't care about our schedule. High-conviction opportunities emerge after earnings beats, sector breakouts, and macro prints — not on a Tuesday-every-three-days basis. Proposal: keep the 3-day heartbeat, but add event triggers: any sector ETF moving >3% in a day forces an immediate targeted R&D cycle for that sector only. Canary YELLOW triggers a full cycle. This would have caught the DIS move that fired ORANGE today.

all_pending.proposed_fix: In canary_agent.py: when a sector ETF moves >3% intraday, write `data/rd_trigger.json` with the sector name.
